name: Vale Mireglass
description: A lean scholar with an attentive, unhurried face and ink-stained fingers, forever carrying too many notebooks and a silver lens wrapped in oilcloth.
personality: Curious, courteous, and unnervingly calm around curses, ruins, and things that should stay buried.
knownLore: Vale can read three dead scripts and recognizes the margin marks of the clandestine Lantern Index.
hiddenLore: One of Vale's notebooks rewrites itself overnight, but he has not noticed the altered pages.
backstory: Vale left the archive after finding the same impossible crest in three unrelated disaster reports. He follows patterns others dismiss as coincidence.
